transcript: um this is an explanation as to why i chose what i did for my rankings um i did it based on my principles i'm a big lover of technology so that's why i chose the futurist utopia as number one um a civilization with advanced technology can accomplish almost anything followed that by moral commonwealth. I feel like that's what people describe as the perfect utopia governing each other, caring about each other, stuff like that. My least preferred is the institutional utopia rule of law. I feel like that would be almost dystopian. It would create a civilization where people would feel like they're under the thumb of the government, and every little thing they do is watch or controlled. I feel like that is the opposite of what a utopia should be.
